examples.english: Wrapped in an capelet of undefined color, with more holes than a pot to fry chestnuts, came Joseliyo, not knowing how, tired from fatigue and with teeth chattering from cold, to the small town square of a peripheral neighborhood of the city.
examples.ref: 1894, J. Gualberto López-Valdemoro, “La lira rota”, in La Ciudad de Dios, volume XXXIV, Madrid: Real Monasterio de San Lorenzo del Escorial, page 124:
examples.text: Envuelto en una capeja de color indefinido y con más agujeros que olla de asar castañas, llegó Joseliyo, sin saber cómo, rendido de fatiga y dando diente con diente, á la plazoleta de un barrio extremo de la ciudad.
examples.translation: Wrapped in an capelet of undefined color, with more holes than a pot to fry chestnuts, came Joseliyo, not knowing how, tired from fatigue and with teeth chattering from cold, to the small town square of a peripheral neighborhood of the city.
